fieldValues.title: RFC-009 Change B: Demote containerType to a derived/validated hint
fieldValues.proposed_change:
On Container: containerType SHOULD equal the resolved root Type name (bare name, not namespace/name) when rootInstanceIds is present. Mismatch is diagnostic-only (I-64), not a validity error. On DocumentView: containerType MUST NOT be used for matching when rootTypeRefs is present. Retained as fallback for pre-RFC-009 tools (DV-Rx1).

**Amended by RFC-043 (effective at dataModelRevision 8).** `containerType` SHOULD equal the resolved Type name of the Container's anchor record when `anchorInstanceId` is present; `rootInstanceIds` is removed ([R4]). (Prior text, in force until a corpus is at revision 8: the statement above.)
fieldValues.rationale: containerType is optional; making mismatch a validity error would penalise authors of existing repos. A SHOULD diagnostic flags stale hints without breaking data.
